dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Overview of the local linguistic landscape database.

database.title: Database
database.subtitle: Manage imported linguistic landscape records.
database.noMatch: No records match the current filters.
database.empty: No records yet. Click “{{button}}” above to upload a package exported from LLMap Mobile.
database.noAlbums: No datasets yet. Imported packages appear here as albums.

import.title: Import Dataset Package
import.introUpload: Upload a package exported by LLMap Mobile ({{pattern}}).
import.introDetail: Records go into the local database; photos are copied into backend storage. Duplicate SignIDs are skipped, never overwritten.
import.notZip: “{{name}}” is not a .zip file. Please select a llmap_dataset_*.zip.
import.selectFirst: Please select a Dataset Package (.zip) first.
import.keepOriginal: Keep the original package in archives/ (uses extra disk space)
import.duplicateBody: An identical package was imported on {{date}} as “{{name}}”. Importing again would add no new records.

map.title: Map
map.subtitle: Spatial distribution of collected records.
map.gpsNote: Only records with latitude and longitude are shown on the map.
map.noMatch: No mapped records match the current filters.
map.noGps: No records with GPS yet. Import a Dataset Package that contains coordinates.

review.title: Review
review.subtitle: Work through records that still need human confirmation (quick captures, standard submissions, AI drafts).
review.confirmDiscard: You have unsaved changes. Discard them and switch record?
review.allReviewed: All selected records have been reviewed.
review.selectPrompt: Select a record from the queue to start reviewing.

export.title: Export
export.subtitle: Export filtered database records for analysis and archiving.
export.csvNote: CSV export uses the current database records and selected filters. System fields such as CaptureID, SignID, EntryMode, DataStatus, SchemaVersion, and AppVersion are included. Photos are not included in CSV export — use the Dataset Package or Photos ZIP export when images are required.
export.formatCsvDesc: All 37 schema columns, UTF-8 with BOM (Excel compatible). Photos are not included.
export.formatDatasetDesc: Full re-export as llmap_dataset zip with photos, manifest and schema.
export.formatGeojsonDesc: Records with GPS as a FeatureCollection for GIS tools.
export.formatPhotosDesc: Crop and source photos of the selected records.
export.dedupNote: Identical photos are included once (content dedup). Missing files are listed in MISSING.txt.
export.geojsonNote: Coordinates are [lng, lat], WGS84. Records without GPS are excluded and the skipped count is recorded in the file.

ai.title: AI Processing
ai.subtitle: Batch AI drafting for large datasets.
ai.note: AI output is a draft — it never overwrites existing content, and humans review before anything becomes final.
ai.rule1: Existing content is never deleted or overwritten — remarks are appended, multi-select fields are unioned, single fields only fill blanks.
ai.rule2: Fields the AI is unsure about (empty values) are never written.
ai.rule3: Status is only promoted pending → ai; human-reviewed / final are never demoted by a re-run.
ai.rule4: Each record is saved individually — cancelling keeps completed work, and re-running never duplicates appends.
ai.goSettings: Enter an API key in Settings → AI.
ai.confirmRun: This will judge {{n}} photos with {{model}} (billable API usage). Continue?
ai.doneSummary: Done: {{changed}} records updated ({{fields}} fields) · {{unchanged}} unchanged · {{skipped}} skipped (no photo) · {{errors}} errors

task.title: v6 field drafting (13 dimensions)
task.desc: Drafts scripturality, main/sub/decorative languages, multilingual relation, carrier type, placement, temporality, legibility, overwriting, discourse type, production quality and remarks from the crop photo. Same prompt and merge rules as the mobile app.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Console configuration. Kept minimal — no accounts, no permissions.
settings.languageDesc: The display language switches immediately and is saved on this device.
settings.languageNote: Data itself is never translated — field keys, CSV headers, API values and internal status values stay unchanged.
settings.exportDirDesc: Export jobs (Dataset Package, Photos ZIP) write their zip directly into this folder. Leave empty to use the default exports folder inside the data directory (desktop: AppData on drive C:).
settings.exportDirSaved: Saved. Future exports will be written to the new folder.
settings.backendHelpPrefix: To change it in web/dev mode, set
settings.backendHelpSuffix: and restart npm run dev. The desktop app injects the URL automatically at startup.
settings.aiDesc: Provider and API keys used by the AI Processing page. Keys are stored only in settings.json on this machine and never returned by the read API.
settings.aiKeyNote: Saving with an empty field keeps the current key.

storage.title: Storage
storage.cleanupConfirm: This will delete {{size}} of legacy import leftovers. Official photos, the database and archives are never touched. Proceed?
storage.cleanupBlocked: Cleanup aborted: {{n}} photos are missing from the official store. Restore them via “Only restore missing photos” first.
storage.resetDesc: Deletes the record database, photos (crops and sources), import leftovers, archived packages, and exports in the default folder. This cannot be undone. Exporting a full Dataset Package backup first is strongly recommended.
storage.resetKeep: Settings (AI keys, export directory) and logs are kept. A configured external export folder is never touched.
